sentences.en: The vile lizard wants to eat your eyes and ears!
sentences.zh: 这条可恶的蜥蜴想吃掉你的眼睛和耳朵!

sentences.en: The maids complained of his drunken habits and his vile language.
sentences.zh: 女仆们抱怨他的酗酒习惯和他的卑鄙言语。

sentences.en: Killing people while they pray is the most vile thing imaginable.
sentences.zh: 在祈祷时杀人是最可恶的事情之一。
